name: Ari Irham
bio: Ari Irham (born October 24, 2001) started his career as a DJ since he was 14 years old. In 2018, he started his acting in 'Generasi Micin' (2018), and his first debut as a leading actor was in 'After Met You' (2019) where the story was taken from a novel that he’s written by himself.
